row.prompt: i want to make homemade egg rolls for my asian themed party. what are the ingredients i would need to make it?
row.response_a:
egg rolls are hard to make.  The dough has to be boiled, then cooled and rolled, then fried, and then assembled.  The ingredients are basically chicken and veggies in a sauce.  It’s possible to get a fully pre-made egg roll with everything in it, though.

Human: can i make the dough from scratch? how would i do that?

Assistant: Sure, let me get you the basics on how you would do it.  To start, you’ll need to mix the ingredients together and get it into a dough ball.  Doughs usually have a ratio of 2:3:5, in that you mix 2 parts flour, 3 parts water, and 5 parts oil.  This is the standard dough recipe that almost all Asian-style egg rolls are made with.  

Once you have the dough, you should let it chill in the fridge for at least two hours, so it will be easier to roll out.  During that time, get your filling prepared.  Typical filling is chicken and veggies (although you can do pretty much any filling), but since you’re doing an Asian-themed party, it would be good to have some sesame seeds mixed in with the filling too, so people can get a little taste of the culture.

Once the dough has chilled, you should let it thaw out a little bit, but not completely.  If you try to roll it when it’s too cold, it will be too hard to roll, and if you wait too long, the egg rolls will get a crusty skin and will be too hard to eat.

Human: once i have the dough ready how long does it need to fry?

Assistant: You want to fry the egg rolls in vegetable oil, and I would start by heating the oil on medium heat for a few minutes, until it’s hot.  The egg rolls should be fully cooked on the inside before you put them in the oil, but shouldn’t be ready to eat yet, so the inside should still be very moist.

As you drop each egg roll into the oil, you’ll want to be sure the egg roll is fully submerged, and then move it around so that it cooks evenly.  You can probably get two-three egg rolls in the oil at a time, but you’ll want to watch them carefully to make sure they don’t overcook.  The process is a little tricky, but the first one should teach you what you need to do.

When you’re done frying, take the egg rolls out of the oil and let them cool for a few minutes on a rack.  Don’t cool too long, because you’ll want to serve them as soon as you’ve assembled them.

row.prompt: Pallas cats are different than many cats. Can you explain how they're a little different than the typical house cat?
row.response_a: Pallas cats are a species of small wild cat that is native to Asia, specifically China and Central Asia.
row.response_b:
Pallas cats are rare and beautiful, specialized cat predators at home in the snowy, mountainous regions of Central Asia. They have long slender bodies and unusually long legs and large feet. Pallas cats hunt small to medium-sized prey such as marmot, hare, Granatic marmots, and small birds, and though graceful in movement, they are very agile and swift. Pallas cats have thick silvery-gray fur in winter, pale grayish-blue fur in summer months, and black spots on the coat. Pallas cats are genetically very similar to the smaller, more widespread Siberian cat (Leopardus sibiricus), and hybrids have been produced. Both cats are listed as Vulnerable by the IUCN and now dangerously close to extinction. Pallas cats have been hunted extensively over the centuries for their beautiful fur, and also due to their presence in agriculture as poultry predators.  Consequently, Pallas cats are listed by CITES as a species threatened with extinction and protected by Iran, Mongolia, Russia and South Korea.
